definition: Seconds from the nearest LBMA Gold Price auction, at 10:30 and 15:00 London time on London weekdays: the bar's close less the auction time, negative before it and positive after.
boundaries: London time follows its daylight-saving rule, so the auctions move in UTC twice a year. UK bank holidays are not modelled. auction 1 keeps the 10:30 auction, 2 the 15:00 auction and 0 both. Bars without a time are missing. QML's unit runtime does not yet pass a bars input its time, so inside a unit this value stays missing until it does.
recognition: A gold unit stands aside in the minutes around the London fix.

sources.quote: The auctions are run at 10:30 and 15:00 London time for gold

golden.reference: local event times from zoneinfo (the IANA tz database), in qml/tests/golden/beyond-fx/reference_run.py
